name: screen-flow-carousel
title: Screen Flow Carousel
description: Screen flow carousel for vertical reels: two to five app-screen skeletons slide through a centred stage one by one, the active screen ringed in brand red with a Montserrat caption under it. Screens count, captions and cues are fields; captions wrap instead of being cut. Brand palette, sized for the 780 px graphics field.

variables.label: Screens
variables.description: How many screens ride the rail.

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Comma-separated caption per screen. Blank entries use the authored defaults.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated advance times in seconds from mount start. Blank entries use the authored even rhythm.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the final screen holds until the cut.
